title: Cards
body: Two ways to use a source in your own words.

_items.title: Rebuild the idea
_items.text: Read the passage, put it away, and write the point in your own sentence. Then cite the source.

_items.title: Swap a few words
_items.text: Keeping the original sentence and changing synonyms is still too close to the source, even with a citation.

_items.title: Keep the meaning
_items.text: A good paraphrase changes the words but not what the author meant. Check it against the original.
